checks.method: count the shipped ProviderQuotaAdapter implementations in lib/ and record the quota_support capability each cloud account model declares
checks.expected_outcome: no shipped adapter reads a provider, and quota support is recorded as a declared capability rather than a fetched value

checks.method: construct provider readings with raw byte counts and a provider unit, and record the byte totals the aggregation derives
checks.expected_outcome: provider byte counts are preserved exactly and summed without a unit conversion the provider did not report

checks.method: render provider byte counts and an unknown quota through the shipped storage-unit formatter and the usage card
checks.expected_outcome: byte counts render in decimal units and an unknown quota renders as unavailable rather than zero

checks.method: measure readings inside and outside the stale window, aggregate them, and read back the freshness label and last_updated value
checks.expected_outcome: a reading inside the window is fresh, one outside it is stale, and an aggregate is dated by its newest included measurement

checks.method: aggregate a mix of included, unavailable, and provider-defined-unit readings and record the partial status, totals, and exclusions
checks.expected_outcome: a total with excluded accounts is partial and names them, and a total with no compatible reading is unavailable rather than zero

checks.method: request an unavailable reading and confirm no total, unit label, or percentage is fabricated in its place
checks.expected_outcome: an unavailable provider yields no bytes, no quota, and no percentage

checks.method: scan local storage, filter the distribution to each scope, and confirm local bytes never enter a cloud quota total and free space is never added to a used total
checks.expected_outcome: local and remote totals stay separable, a merged total is labelled and warned, and free space is never added to a used total
